LBY.note: Cabinet Decision 40 of 2025 creates an AI programme with no mandate over AI harms.

systems.system: National Programme for AI and Digital Transformation

LBY.note: Decision sets up a programme with a mandate to speed government processes with AI; no AI system in use, tender or pilot is stated.
No sector AI tool is stated.
No model, dataset or compute is stated as built or planned with a named site.
Nothing on control or hosting of state data in the decision text.
